prompt:
采用竖版上下两格漫画布局，两格大小一致，纵向排列。整体背景色和文字区背景色一致。
每格都采用上图下文的结构，上方约80%的区域为完整的场景插画，下方约20%的区域为横向文字说明栏。
图片占满上方区域左右无边框，文字栏紧贴图片底部，使用浅色背景。文字左对齐，以阿拉伯数字编号开头。
上下两格之间用细横线分隔，保持统一的图片比例、文字栏高度和左右边距。每格表现一个独立的生活场景，整体布局简洁规整，不添加额外装饰。

本次输入：【填写角色外观、首尾场景、按顺序发生的画格事件、原样保留的对白】。
有事实、名称、数字或引文时，按输入使用；信息缺失的模块留空或省略。
promptEnglish:
Adopt a vertical two-panel comic storyboard layout, with two equally sized panels stacked vertically. The overall canvas background color and the text area background color are identical.
Each panel uses an "image on top, text below" structure: the upper ~80% area is a complete scene illustration, and the lower ~20% area is a horizontal caption bar.
The illustration fills the upper area with no left or right borders, and the caption bar sits directly beneath the illustration against a light background. Text is left-aligned, starting with an Arabic numeral number.
The two panels are separated by a thin horizontal dividing line, maintaining uniform image aspect ratios, caption bar heights, and left/right margins. Each panel depicts an independent everyday life scene, creating a clean, orderly layout without extra decorative clutter.

Inputs: [Provide character appearance, opening and closing scenes, ordered panel events, and the exact dialogue].
Use supplied facts, names, numbers and quotations. Leave sections without data blank or omit them.
